lead: Harivansh Rai Bachchan was a poet, born on 27 November 1907 in Prayagraj.
He died on 18 January 2003 in Mumbai at the age of 95.
He is associated with work such as Do Chattanen and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
This profile collects the Harivansh facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Harivansh Rai Bachchan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Harivansh Rai Bachchan was born on 27 November 1907 in Prayagraj, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name his father, Pratap Narayan Shrivastava and his mother, Saraswati Devi Shrivastava.
He received his education at St Catharine's College.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi.

sections.heading: Harivansh Rai Bachchan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists poet, politician and prose writer as his occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Harivansh are Do Chattanen.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha.
